mapper.sql: c.id, c.reporter_id, r.name AS reporter_name, r.phone AS reporter_phone, r.email AS reporter_email, r.relation AS reporter_relation, c.case_number, c.status, c.report_content, c.missing_name, c.gender, c.birth_year, c.hair, c.face, c.upper_clothing, c.lower_clothing, c.shoes, c.belongings, c.body_type, c.distinctive_features, c.photo_s3_key, c.last_seen_time, c.last_seen_lat, c.last_seen_lng, c.last_seen_address, c.reported_at, c.closed_at, c.created_at, c.updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reporters (name, phone, email, relation, created_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{relation}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))

INSERT INTO cases ( reporter_id, case_number, status, report_content, missing_name, gender, birth_year, hair, face, upper_clothing, lower_clothing, shoes, belongings, body_type, distinctive_features, last_seen_time, last_seen_lat, last_seen_lng, last_seen_address, reported_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{reporterId}, #{caseNumber}, #{status}, #{reportContent}, #{missingName}, #{gender}, #{birthYear}, #{hair}, #{face}, #{upperClothing}, #{lowerClothing}, #{shoes}, #{belongings}, #{bodyType}, #{distinctiveFeatures}, #{lastSeenTime,typeHandler=com.ssafy.eyesonu.common.persistence.mybatis.UtcInstantTypeHandler}, #{lastSeenLat}, #{lastSeenLng}, #{lastSeenAddress}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM cases c INNER JOIN reporters r ON r.id = c.reporter_id WHERE c.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM cases c INNER JOIN reporters r ON r.id = c.reporter_id
ORDER BY
c.updated_at c.missing_name c.reported_at
ASC DESC , c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE cases SET report_content = #{reportContent}, missing_name = #{missingName}, gender = #{gender}, birth_year = #{birthYear}, hair = #{hair}, face = #{face}, upper_clothing = #{upperClothing}, lower_clothing = #{lowerClothing}, shoes = #{shoes}, belongings = #{belongings}, body_type = #{bodyType}, distinctive_features = #{distinctiveFeatures}, last_seen_time = #{lastSeenTime,typeHandler=com.ssafy.eyesonu.common.persistence.mybatis.UtcInstantTypeHandler}, last_seen_lat = #{lastSeenLat}, last_seen_lng = #{lastSeenLng}, last_seen_address = #{lastSeenAddress}, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM search_conditions WHERE case_id = #{caseId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM case_cameras WHERE case_id = #{caseId} AND search_enabled = TRUE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM candidates WHERE case_id = #{caseId} AND review_status = 'PENDING'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_jobs WHERE case_id = #{caseId} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')
mapper.update: UPDATE analysis_jobs SET status = 'CANCELLED', completed_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE case_id = #{caseId} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')
